groups.name: Storage and drive carriers
groups.description: Drive carriers, storage backplane and expander connect the storage subsystem. Representation: cad_derived.

groups.name: Cooling fan assembly
groups.description: Six source fan modules move air through the chassis; no airflow or RPM is simulated. Representation: cad_derived.

groups.name: Processor and socket assemblies
groups.description: Two POWER9-family processor/socket/loading assemblies. U1 and U10 identify sockets, not CPU ordering codes. Representation: cad_derived.

groups.name: Processor heatsinks
groups.description: Source Furukawa cooling assemblies conduct heat from the processor modules to passing air. Representation: cad_derived.

groups.name: Network adapter
groups.description: Selected dual-port 25GbE OCP adapter and mounting hardware. Distinct from the management controller's network path. Representation: cad_derived.

groups.name: Power input and conversion
groups.description: 48 V input, selected board power conversion components and their cooling. No electrical simulation or live telemetry. Representation: cad_derived.

groups.name: Chassis and mounting structure
groups.description: Supports and locates the server's internal assemblies. Representation: cad_derived.

groups.name: Motherboard and board components
groups.description: EVT3 motherboard with source-derived component placements and reconstructed package appearance. Representation: source_derived_reconstruction.

groups.name: Host memory modules
groups.description: 32 supported-class RDIMM analogues at source socket positions. Installed module SKU and capacity are not established. Representation: supported_class_analogue.

limits: The detail library omits the removable cover; switching to this open interior does not recover or detach an authored cover.
Hardware below2.5mm and individual memory contacts are omitted in this sample overview recipe.
RDIMMs are supported-class analogues; exact installed SKU/capacity are not established.
Source relationships describe design evidence, not live measurements or simulated circuits.
Separate detailed component and illustrative processor study exports are not included.
